system.description:
Once used by security and emergency services to bypass locks and other security systems in an emergency, these tools — including electromagnetic scramblers, radio frequency jammers, infrared dazzlers, nanotech lockpicks, and similar devices to blind, overwhelm, or confuse security systems — were also extremely useful to those with more illicit intentions. Today, they’re a valuable tool for anyone trying to get into secured sections of ancient ruins.

A bypass kit allows a character to attempt a Skill Test to unlock a locked door or disable a security system. A bypass kit is a powered device which recharges after a Break rest.
